brief:
Rep. Brad Schneider, a Jewish Democrat in Congress, called on the Israeli occupation government to prosecute settlers involved in attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank, describing them as "extremist terrorists," Shehab Wire reported. Schneider's statement came as calls intensify within his party regarding settler violence in the occupied territory.

The congressman urged Israeli authorities to bring the accused settlers to justice, framing the issue as a matter of accountability for attacks on Palestinians.
